# vLLM

Verified against **vLLM v0.33.0** (released 2026-11-02) using the v0.33.0 source,
docs.vllm.ai (stable) and Docker Hub on 2026-11-13. Re-verify flags when changing versions.

## Image

`vllm/vllm-openai:v0.33.0@sha256:d825baf9ce4b1b6bfc5ecc7b79880c7e6748c65a72d697ce3d47607aafa84c6e`
(amd64 + arm64). CUDA 13.0 images: the host needs an R580+ driver. The image ENTRYPOINT is
`vllm serve`, so the model is passed positionally after the image name.

## Launch (generated by `inferencelab backend launch-plan`)

```bash
docker run -d --gpus all --ipc=host -p 127.0.0.1:8000:8000 \
  -v ~/.cache/huggingface:/root/.cache/huggingface --env-file ~/.inferencelab/env \
  vllm/vllm-openai:v0.33.0@sha256:d825… \
  Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 \
  --served-model-name qwen2.5-7b-instruct --revision a09a35458c702b33eeacc393d103063234e8bc28 \
  --generation-config vllm --enable-prompt-tokens-details --dtype bfloat16 \
  --max-model-len 8192 --max-num-seqs 256 --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 --enable-prefix-caching --enable-chunked-prefill
```

| Deployment field | vLLM flag |
|---|---|
| `max_context` | `--max-model-len` |
| `max_concurrency` | `--max-num-seqs` (default depends on GPU memory — always pin) |
| `max_batched_tokens` | `--max-num-batched-tokens` |
| `gpu_memory_utilization` | `--gpu-memory-utilization` (default 0.92) |
| `parallelism.tensor/pipeline/data/expert` | `--tensor-parallel-size`, `--pipeline-parallel-size`, `--data-parallel-size`, `--enable-expert-parallel` |
| `prefix_caching` | `--enable-prefix-caching` / `--no-enable-prefix-caching` (default on) |
| `chunked_prefill` | `--enable-chunked-prefill` / `--no-enable-chunked-prefill` (default on; disabling is not officially supported) |
| `lora` | `--enable-lora --max-loras --max-lora-rank --lora-modules name=path` |
| `speculative` | `--speculative-config '{"method": …, "num_speculative_tokens": N, "model": draft}'` (`ngram`, `draft_model`, `eagle`, `eagle3`, `mtp`) |
| `quantization` | none for pre-quantized checkpoints (AWQ/GPTQ/FP8 auto-detected; `awq`, `awq_marlin` and `auto_awq` are aliases); `--quantization fp8` for online FP8 |

The `--no-enable-X` spelling is used because v0.32 and v0.33 both accept it (`--disable-X`
is new in v0.33). `--generation-config vllm` stops the checkpoint's
`generation_config.json` (Qwen2.5: temperature 0.7, top_p 0.8, top_k 20, repetition
penalty 1.05) from changing sampling. `--enable-prompt-tokens-details` makes usage report
`prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens`. **Never pass `--disable-log-stats`**: it removes
every `vllm:*` metric.

## HTTP behaviour used by InferenceLab

* `GET /health` (200 when healthy, 503 if the engine died; connections are refused while
  the model loads), `/v1/models`, `/version` (`{"version": "0.33.0"}`), `/metrics`.
* Streaming: `stream_options.include_usage` adds a final `choices: []` chunk with usage
  before `[DONE]`.
* Client disconnect aborts the request server-side (streaming and non-streaming).
* Structured output: OpenAI `response_format` (`json_schema`, `json_object`) or vLLM's
  `structured_outputs`; the old `guided_*` fields were removed in v0.12.
* `ignore_eos`, `min_tokens`, `top_k` are accepted as extensions.

## Metrics mapping (`backends/vllm/backend.py`)

| BackendMetrics | vLLM sample (fallback for pre-0.11 servers) |
|---|---|
| running / waiting | `vllm:num_requests_running`, `vllm:num_requests_waiting` |
| KV usage (0–1) | `vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc` (`vllm:gpu_cache_usage_perc`) |
| prefix cache queries / hits (tokens) | `vllm:prefix_cache_queries_total`, `vllm:prefix_cache_hits_total` (`vllm:gpu_prefix_cache_*`) |
| preemptions | `vllm:num_preemptions_total` |
| prompt / generation tokens | `vllm:prompt_tokens_total`, `vllm:generation_tokens_total` |
| speculative acceptance | `vllm:spec_decode_num_accepted_tokens_total` / `…num_draft_tokens_total` |
| phase means over a run | `vllm:request_queue_time_seconds`, `…prefill_time_seconds`, `…decode_time_seconds`, `vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds`, `vllm:inter_token_latency_seconds`, `vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds` (`_sum`/`_count` deltas) |

## Model support

`Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct` (`a09a3545…`, Apache-2.0, BF16) and
`Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-AWQ` (`b2503754…`, 4-bit AWQ, group 128) are natively supported
(`Qwen2ForCausalLM`, LoRA and pipeline parallel supported). Native context 32k; YaRN
extension is not used in these experiments.
